_about: Small byte patches the runtime needs for a specific build of a program, keyed by the SHA-256 of its main executable (default.xbe). Each patch overwrites bytes at a virtual address after load. Only programs listed here get patches; anything else is translated unmodified. Nothing here contains program code beyond a few replacement bytes.

patches.why: voice-chat engine init needs audio-processor voice tables the runtime does not provide; report 'no voice engine' (xor eax,eax; ret)
